page.overview:
Who is Darth Angral?

Darth Angral was a Human male Sith Lord serving the resurgent Sith Empire during the time of the Great Galactic War. Known across the galaxy for his lust for blood, he led the Sacking of Coruscant and killed Supreme Chancellor Berooken himself. He was one of the Sith Lords that felt offended by the Treaty of Coruscant that followed afterwards.

During the Cold War, Angral sent his son, Tarnis, to infiltrate the Galactic Republic and steal the Planet Prison superweapon from Coruscant. When Tarnis was killed at the hands of a rising Jedi Knight, Angral vowed to unleash his vengeance across the entire galaxy.

In his quest for revenge, Angral sent his subordinates and Sith apprentices to combine more components with the Planet Prison for his latest weapon: the Desolator. With it, he would destroy the Jedi Order and the Republic by taking out a single planet. However, it came at a cost: Watcher One was apprehended by the Knight who killed Tarnis; his apprentices Sadic and Nefarid were killed; and Praven was turned to the light side of the Force and welcomed by the Jedi. Despite the losses, Angral had what he needed.

After testing the firepower of the Desolator on Uphrades, Angral set his sights on the Jedi homeworld of Tython. The Knight and their Padawan, Kira Carsen, boarded Angral's flagship Oppressor and confronted the waiting Sith Lord. There, the Voice of the Sith Emperor possessed Carsen as she was one of his Children, commanding Angral to destroy the Knight. Angral fought hard in the Emperor's name, but he was no match for the strength of the Jedi who would become known as the Hero of Tython.
